results.name: Wooden Dining Chair
results.description:
# **Based off a chair in my backyard**

I used **PolyCam** to create a 3D model using **photogrammetry** 

**Then exported to blender and made a version with better topology**

After that I **baked the textures** from the 3D scan to my Blender version,
and then **touched up the textures** to fix parts the scan didn't 
get quite right.

# **This model has clean UV maps and subdivision ready topology**

results.name: Mercury Chair Regency Period
results.description:
A model of a regency dining chair featuring the God of Financial Gain Mercury. This is for a much larger project of a regency banquet table that ages over time in Unreal Engine 4.26. results.name: Luxury Baroque Dining Chair
results.description:
This 3D model represents a luxurious Baroque-style dining chair, featuring a beautifully carved silver wooden frame and plush black upholstered seat and backrest. The backrest is designed with elegant tufted details and decorative studs, giving it a regal and timeless look.

This type of chair is widely used in:

European interiors (France, Italy, UK) for classic dining rooms and royal-inspired designs.Middle Eastern interiors (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait) for luxury palaces, hotels, and banquet halls.American interiors (USA, Canada) for high-end dining areas, event halls, and wedding furniture.Asian interiors (Turkey, China, India) for luxury restaurants, event setups, and formal spaces.Perfect for interior visualization, event decoration, architectural renders, furniture catalogs, and luxury game assets.

Model Features:

High-quality polygonal modelingRealistic silver finish with black fabricSuitable for close-up rendersReady for interior projects and visualizations
